text: Whilst everyone builds Java-style dashboards and second brains for their businesses that don't really do anything other than act as glorified text documents with an index which has existed for decades, I've been giving my automated hedge funds a makeover. This is Algrie and it looked like this at the start of the year and now it looks like this. And you might be thinking this is just a nothing burger full of gimmicks. Each one of these panels is a condensed version of one of my full tabs all with their own unique functions that are vital for Algrie to produce trading bots the way it does. Comment Algo and I'll send you a link to try this out completely free of charge.
